desc: NebuLink Gateway NLG8600 is a SCADA RTU unit for remote logic control and monitoring in industrial applications. Powered by an ARM Cortex-A7 processor with RS232, RS485, Ethernet, cellular, analog and digital I/O, it lets users implement control logic using the pre-programmed QuecOpen OS, and is built for low-cost, battery-enabled M2M applications.

overview: NebuLink Gateway NLG8600 is a SCADA RTU unit for remote logic control and monitoring in various industrial applications. It is powered by an ARM Cortex-A7 processor with multiple interfaces: RS232, RS485, Ethernet, cellular, analog and digital I/Os.

It supports the QuecOpen SDK for programming and configuration, with validated Modbus RTU, Modbus TCP and DLMS stacks that ease integration with SCADA software. A built-in lightweight web server covers Ethernet, GSM and peripherals; an RTC supports real-time scheduling; and SSL/TLS is supported.

Compact size, easy fitting and battery support (a 3.7 V / 4.2 V rechargeable battery can take over control when mains is absent) make it well suited to battery-based M2M solutions and shorten end users' time to market. It is covered by a two-year warranty.

why.d: Implement control logic on the controller with the pre-programmed QuecOpen OS.
Validated Modbus RTU, Modbus TCP and DLMS stacks; Modbus/TCP for seamless integration.
10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet plus LTE for remote access, with SSL/TLS.
Rechargeable battery keeps control active when mains supply is absent.
2-way isolation and ESD protection on analog and digital I/O.
